tools.name: render_pdf
tools.description: Render a web page to PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP or Markdown. Returns the download URL of the finished file; fetch it with your API key as the Bearer token.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Report the calling key's monthly quota state: tier, calendar month, renders used, monthly limit, remaining renders, and the date the count resets.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: List the pricing tiers with their monthly price in USD and their included monthly conversions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "render_pdf" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
